comparison.objective: Replace a toilet roll and refit a spring spindle; candidate preassembles a collet and nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Load a roll, compress a spring spindle, seat one end, and steer the free end into a socket versus small-part eccentric capture and snap engagement.
comparison.success_condition: New roll on spindle, both ends seated, tube removed, hands off and stable versus collet retained after release.
comparison.reason: Both include retention, but the spring-spindle bimanual steering ability is mechanically different.
